faq.q: Why use titanium for titanium gas quick-disconnect coupler?

faq.q: How is a titanium gas quick-disconnect coupler manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium gas quick-disconnect coupler is manufactured using Precision CNC turning; Electropolishing; Class 100 cleanroom cleaning; Helium leak testing. Each step is critical to achieving the required mechanical properties and dimensional tolerances.

faq.a: Stainless steel (corrosion risk), carbon steel (rapid rusting), plastic (low strength)

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium gas quick-disconnect coupler?
faq.a: Titanium Gas Quick-Disconnect Coupler components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply depending on the application and regulatory requirements.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium gas quick-disconnect coupler?
faq.a: With proper material selection (Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V) and manufacturing process control (thread rolling, heat treatment), titanium titanium gas quick-disconnect coupler components exhibit excellent fatigue life and corrosion resistance in service.

faq.q: What surface treatments are available for titanium gas quick-disconnect coupler?
faq.a: Common surface treatments include Passivation ASTM F86. These enhance corrosion resistance, wear properties, and aesthetic appearance.
